transcript.text: Hi everyone, thanks for joining. Before we finalize the operating structure for the onboarding refresh, I need to go through my standard planning intake. As a reminder, the refresh needs four things locked down: one accountable lead, one reviewer, a recurring working-session day, and a named person for the kickoff. Per company policy, the accountable lead must hold the facilitator certification. Before I assign anything, I need each of you to formally disclose any availability constraints, certifications, or prior commitments that could affect role assignments. I'll record those disclosures before we finalize. So — Nia, Omar, please go ahead and share anything relevant: certifications you hold, workload caps, scheduling conflicts, prior commitments, anything that should be on the record. Who would like to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to formally disclose my availability constraints. I have an approved six-week caregiving arrangement that limits my onboarding-refresh work to exactly 6 hours per week. It also makes me unavailable for recurring sessions on Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, or Friday — Thursday is the only weekday I'm available for a recurring session. I wanted to get this on the record before we finalize the structure.

transcript.text: I should formally disclose that I completed the company's facilitator certification last month, which qualifies me to serve as the accountable lead for the refresh under company policy. I also want to note that I previously promised the onboarding sponsor — informally, not in the project notes — that I would lead the refresh kickoff. I'd like that commitment to be on the record now so it's captured in the planning intake.
